info.description: REST API of the Sprachweg German language course platform
info.title: Sprachweg API

get.summary: Certificate as PDF (A4 landscape); revoked certificates carry a stamp
Issued certificates of a course (newest first), optionally filtered by name, e-mail or code

post.summary: Issue a certificate manually (override), also when the learner does not meet the criteria

get.summary: Gradebook as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM, localized headers)
Learner progress table as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM, localized headers)
Learner report as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM, localized headers)
All attempts of a quiz/exam with per-question points as CSV
Verify a certificate code (no personal data beyond the name on the certificate); unknown codes → 404 CERTIFICATE_NOT_FOUND, too many lookups → 429 RATE_LIMITED
My certificates (newest first, including revoked ones)
My certificate as PDF (A4 landscape); lang=en|de overrides the course's language
Certificate status for a course: NOT_ENABLED, IN_PROGRESS (with criteria), ISSUED or REVOKED
